4381583454744905572:
Years later, facing the flocks of Giant Geese roaming the wilderness outside Mo City, I could still recall the day the Pigeon arrived.
I knew this Pigeon carried an invitation to the grand banquet of my sect, but at this moment, should I open the window to let it in or close it and pretend I never saw the bird?
As Mozi once said, "A city without complete defenses cannot protect itself. A mind without preparation cannot respond to emergencies."
Thus, whenever faced with a major life decision, I jot down all the tangled thoughts in my heart—perhaps the answer will surface on its own.

Hypothesis One:
If I attend, the Elder will surely greet me with a beaming smile and a raised cup of Wine. My fellow disciples will gather around the hearth, sharing drinks and stories, discussing Mo City's affairs and lofty ambitions. Yet after a few rounds, someone might stand to pose a philosophical challenge. As the saying goes, "Speech should not aim for quantity but wisdom, not eloquence but insight." If my words prove wise, it will become another celebrated tale among our sect. But if I ramble and falter, my academic standing will surely decline, and I might spend at least half a year brooding over this misstep, disheartened...

Hypothesis Two:
If I decline, the Elder will frown and sigh inwardly. My peers will whisper about my arrogance and lack of camaraderie. Yet I could seize this chance to claim the overly coveted floating workshop, secluding myself to develop the latest mechanisms. Perhaps, deep in the mountains, inspiration will strike, unlocking endless inventions and crowning me the new master of ingenuity. Or I might stray into delusion, my work derailed, leaving me with nothing to submit even if my graduation is delayed. Still, if I deliberately skip the banquet, the Elder may hold a grudge, complicating future interactions...

Hypothesis Three:
If I linger in indecision, torn between going and not going, I might miss both the gathering with the Elder and the focus needed for my research. This dilemma is vexing! Overthinking breeds melancholy—and hair loss. Right now, I crave a solitary binge; perhaps after three rounds of Wine, bold resolve will guide me to decide whether to attend tomorrow... Wait, speaking of drinks, a roasted Pigeon would pair splendidly...

Ah! Perhaps the finest answer has already emerged between "Pigeon or not"—truly, as Zhenzhen said, "Force is the means by which form achieves momentum."...
